Aim.desc: Hunters can focus in combat while remaining still, allowing them to make near-impossible shots.
Aim.name: Focus

Atunement.desc: Attunement of 10 is the Steady state. Lower numbers are Battle attunement, higher are Healing attunement.
Atunement.name: Attunement

Burden.desc: At 10 Burden, Frodo becomes Corrupted. +30% melee damage, can only use melee skills.
Burden.name: Burden

Dread.desc: The Witch-king builds Dread with his vicious melee attacks and spends it on his foul magic.
Dread.name: Dread

ElementalPower.desc: As Saruman releases the elements upon his enemies, he gains Elemental Power. In turn he can release this power upon a single target, buff his allies, or create hotspots that deal AoE damage to his foes.
ElementalPower.name: Elemental Power

Faronil_Aim.desc: Faronil can focus in combat while remaining still, allowing her to make near-impossible shots.
Faronil_Aim.name: Focus

Fervor.desc: Champion skills are fuelled by righteous fervour in combat.
Fervor.name: Fervour

Fervour_Berserker.desc: Champion skills are fuelled by righteous fervour in combat.
Fervour_Berserker.name: Fervour

Gandalf_Embers.desc:
Ignite and Narya leaves smouldering Embers on Gandalf's targets. Each Ember enhances Combustion:

1 Ember: Increased Combustion damage
2 Embers: Combustion damages all enemies with 10m of the target

Changing targets clears all Ember pips.
Gandalf_Embers.name: Ember

Gandalf_Energy.desc: Energy is consumed via skill play.
Gandalf_Energy.name: Energy

Grace.desc: The Red-maid gains Grace by healing her allies, and loses it when she unleashes her most potent attacks.
Grace.name: Grace

Grish_Bite.desc: The wounds inflicted by the bite of a Warg exposes weaknesses in his enemies armour. \n \n Damage of all skills is increased by 20% when target has a pip on him.
Grish_Bite.name: Bite

Grish_Energy.desc: Energy is consumed via skill play.
Grish_Energy.name: Energy

Lazoz_Bodkin.desc: Each Bodkin Arrow pip allows Lazoz's skills to ignore a portion of his target's Physical Armour.  Revenge and Vital Target consume all available Bodkin pips.
Lazoz_Bodkin.name: Bodkin Arrow

Lazoz_Energy.desc: Energy is consumed via skill play.
Lazoz_Energy.name: Energy

Mettle.desc: A Brawler's joy of battle drives them to seemingly preternatural strength as they fight.
Mettle.name: Mettle

Momentum.desc: As Fury increases, so does the damage and healing done by your skills.
Momentum.name: Fury

Prowess.name: Prowess

Rage.desc: Gimli builds Rage by using Reckless Attack, Whirling Dervish, Natural Sprinter, and forty-THREE!.  At max Rage, Gimli enters Dwarf-fury and he both deals and takes 40% more damage.

Rampage.desc: Trolls measure success by the sound their foes make as they fall to the ground. The more 'Thuds', the stronger the troll!
Rampage.name: Rampage

Wrath.desc: Beornings use Wrath to fuel their most potent skills, especially those that require Bear-form.
